title: Hole is deeper than you think #musicaltheatre #comedy #musical #satire
transcript: We finally got a musical comedy about a religious cult that uses butt plugs to survive the apocalypse, and I don't know why it took so long. Hot off their hit run at Edinburgh Fringe, HOLE! is a new musical featuring two performers, one at a piano, one doing other sorts of sound and visual effects, and both playing all of the characters in this story with surprising intricacy and scope. In the first couple scenes, I got a little bit nervous that it was gonna be like a one trick pony, a show with essentially one joke repeated for 75 minutes. But ultimately they managed to take this already insane premise to some wild, unexpected places. It blends the hero's journey format with a gay awakening romance, and along the way reveals a lot of world building details, sometimes with questionable logic, but unquestionable hilarity. And as ridiculous as it is from start to finish, there is a certain emotional core to it, along with a kind of subversive reflection on religious zealotry in conversation with queer identity, but also very much unlike other media that tackles that conversation, if that wasn't clear. HOLE! is created by the duo American Sing-Song, which has a great and very fitting acronym. And they just finished up a run at Joe's Pub in New York, but they're actually coming back to Joe's Pub in May, and I imagine they'll probably wanna perform it in various places after that. So if you missed it this time around, keep your eyes open for it.
